query: What CFA/IRT steps and sample-size targets will we use to validate the 10–12 item trust instrument, define a short-form, and link latent trust factors to adherence in multilevel mediation tests?

response.query: What CFA/IRT steps and sample-size targets will we use to validate the 10–12 item trust instrument, define a short-form, and link latent trust factors to adherence in multilevel mediation tests?
response.answer: Use confirmatory factor analysis (CFA) and item response theory (IRT) for validation; aim for a sample size of at least 200 for CFA. Define a short-form based on factor loadings and item discrimination parameters. Link latent trust factors to adherence in multilevel mediation tests.
